MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 texgen.js authors

Upstream compiles each generator with new Function(). GifOS CSP is
script-src 'unsafe-inline' with no unsafe-eval, so that cannot run.
vendor/texgen.js is the same operators, params and pixels with a fill()
per generator instead of a compiled string. The live editor (layers,
ops, tint, PNG out) is the GifOS surface; settings stay in the file.
TexGen.orig.js is the pinned original and is not packed.
